notes.title: Update 8.8 - Chaos Deflect AI & New Player Buffs
notes.content:
Changelog:

- New AI System - Chaos Deflect (Experimental). The AI has been upgraded with a brand-new Chaos Deflect system, replacing precise parries with complete anarchy. This makes the game slightly easier—but not too much. An aggressive playstyle is now highly rewarded, as enemies will relentlessly spam the block button while you're attacking, pushing the system to its limit and leaving themselves open. For now, you can switch between the old and new system at any time.

- Substitution Down – now deadlier than ever.
- Substitution Up – increased speed and improved chaining. Now allows for instant follow-ups with Special Attack Forward, Special Attack Up, or any other action.
- Special Attack Forward – improved enemy tracking.

- Upgraded to DLSS 4 – should be a nice boost for mid-tier GPUs.

- Volcanic Map Shader Update – improved visuals and effects for a more immersive experience.

- Camera System Improved – enhanced cinematic sequences and overall camera behavior for a smoother, more immersive experience.

- AI Tweaks – additional improvements to enemy behavior.

- Updated Parry & Damage Effects – new visuals for parries and hit reactions.

- Camera Shake Enhancements – adjusted for better impact feel.

- Burn Damage Increased – fire is now an even bigger threat (or not?).

- Old Bugs Fixed, New Ones Added – because it wouldn’t be an update otherwise.

Now, Kuro's attacks are at peak effectiveness against bosses. Parry and strike back, dodge and punish, bait and cheese — choose your strategy and take down any enemy. Good luck!

notes.title: Update 8.7 - Cheat Menu & Deflect System Update
notes.content:
Changelog:

[b]1)[/b] Deflect System Tweaks
Parrying just got an adjustment to make it more intuitive while still rewarding skill. The system works in 5 stages—each reducing the deflect window as you mistime or spam your parries. The breakdown:

Stage 1 (Idle): 23 frames
Stage 2: 20 frames
Stage 3: 17 frames
Stage 4: 14 frames
Stage 5 (Spam): No parry—only an endless block. 

Stages are rolled back by cooldown. Successful deflects reset you to Stage 2.
[b]If you spam block, you’ll get destroyed. Precision is key.[/b]
For context: Sekiro's standard parry window is 12 frames. To balance things out, bosses unleash twice or even three times as many attacks. Good luck.

[b]2)[/b] Cheat Menu—Because I’m That Kind of Developer
Yes, I added cheats. Yes, they’re right in the Settings menu. Want infinite chakra? Want to spam black fireballs? Now you can.
But do you really think this choice comes without consequences?
Go ahead. Activate them.
The punishment awaits 😈

[b]3)[/b] Starting from the second phase, bosses will now always open with the same attack. Learn it, adapt, and counter accordingly.

[b]4)[/b] And as tradition demands—old bugs have been fixed, while new ones have been added.

notes.title: Update 8.4 - Speedrun Mode is Here!
notes.content:
Update 8.4 brings the Speedrun Mode, complete with an in-game timer and the ability to skip ALL cutscenes after finishing the game once. No interruptions—just pure, fast-paced gameplay!

Other changes include:

-Smarter AI: Enemies now react and adapt better.
-Boss Buffs: Stronger bosses to balance the previous update.
-Jump After Parry: Smooth movement mechanics to enhance combat flow.
-Boat and Hoverboard Speed: Added a secret way to speed them up—find it if you can!
-Special-Down Attack Buff: Faster and more effective in battles.
-Bug fixes to ensure smoother gameplay.

notes.title: Update 8.3 - Faster Moves, Smarter Fights
notes.content:
Your feedback matters, and I’ve been listening! Some players mentioned that Kuro's attack animations felt too slow — so I’ve reworked the longest animations for both Kuro and the first boss. The result? Faster, more dynamic combat that makes both the player and the boss stronger!

Here’s what’s new in v8.3:

- New parry system
- Improved responsiveness (input during animations).
- Smarter AI: Enemies are now more intelligent and challenging, but to balance it out, they block more frequently, allowing you to press them further.
- Enhanced Movement: The Handspring HyperJump now works with double jumps, giving players greater mobility and freedom.
- Bug fixes

notes.title: UPDATE 8.0 - FINAL CHAPTERS
notes.content:
**Changelog**

1. Two final chapters, marking the conclusion of Kuro’s journey.
2. Enhanced animations, sounds, effects, and cutscenes.
3. Polished gameplay mechanics.
4. Adjusted damage balance.
5. Ancient UI from version 2.0 finally replaced with a new, beautiful(?) design.
6. Health of the first boss reduced again – now 60 HP per phase on the easiest difficulty (down from 80), while the player has 100 HP. Second boss HP reduced from 100 to 80 per phase. This is the last adjustment to ease entry; no further reductions.
7. Rare bug fix: triggers will now return players to the battle arena if they somehow end up behind a wall.
8. New trajectory calculation system for Jump QTE.
9. More hints added to the death screen (now scrollable).
10. Duration of Block QTE sequences now scales with enemy health. Be cautious when the enemy is near defeat.
11. Special attack input via dash removed. Dash is now safer in combat, letting players close the distance quickly and initiate combos.
12. Color correction and optimization for every location.
13. Fireballs and other attacks now properly interact with downed players, giving an advantage.
14. Chakra spheres now pass through obstacles, homing in on the player.
15. New logic for double jumps and Rush; they now recharge on a timer. Legend has it that the right sequence lets you fly.
16. Shiro's body no longer clips through her clothing.
17. Fixed bug with randomly missing subtitles.
18. AI now utilizes Dash-Jump technique.
19. Training locations revamped.
20. Old bugs fixed and, as always, new ones added!

notes.title: Update 6.1 - Player-Requested Changes and Improvements
notes.content:
[b]Changelog:[/b]

1. At players' request, added the ability to control with the stick (D-pad functionality fully transferred to the left stick).
2. Added icons for the keyboard (for both layouts), totaling 3 control schemes, which can be changed at any time from the pause menu.
3. Balance adjusted in favor of the player; enemies will make more mistakes.
4. Improved the Rush function (quick double-tap jump), ensuring the character always hits the target, no matter where it flies.
5. Increased action buffering time to 0.5 seconds – you can input a desired action, and it will execute at the end of the current animation. Also fixed the buffering for regular attacks. Some players complained about poor responsiveness – this should address those concerns.
6. Shader corrections in the first location.
7. Standardized all widgets to a unified format.
8. Fixed a bug with incorrect facing direction during grabs in certain situations. Also greatly increased grab distance – airborne grabs can now be performed from afar.
9. The boat camera can now be controlled with the keyboard.
10. Increased running speed from 1500 units to 2000.
11. Added the ability to speedrun using Dash – maintaining the timing allows you to run faster than Usain Bolt. Useful in certain locations.
12. Fixed minor bugs and introduced new ones (classic).

notes.title: Update 6.0 - Shadows of the Past
notes.content:
Patch Notes:

[b]New Chapters:[/b]
  
Added 2 new chapters, including a crucial plot chapter.

[b]Camera Improvements:[/b]
  
Enhanced camera functions.
Smooth disappearance of certain objects when the camera gets close.

[b]Combat Adjustments:[/b]
  
More responsive parrying and buffered actions after current animations.
Adjusted aerial combat physics.
Introduction of Jump QTE, making it easier to avoid wall collision damage (previously almost impossible).

[b]Healing and Chakra:[/b]
  
Added the ability to HEAL in exchange for chakra.
Noticeable effect when lacking chakra for specific actions.
Chakra accumulation speed increased by 1.5 times.

[b]Character and Animation Enhancements:[/b]
  
Redesigned many of Kuro’s animations for smoother and more visually appealing movements.
Added horizontal flight animation.

[b]Gameplay Mechanics:[/b]
  
Reduced health of the first boss (80 HP per stage instead of 100).
Surprise awaits if you fail Attack QTE in the second phase of any boss.
Satoru’s zombies can now be exploded with black fireballs.
Game pauses if the gamepad is disconnected.

[b]User Interface:[/b]
  
Added the ability to translate texts in Kuro's Reflections via Google Translate to the player’s native language due to the high level of English used.

[b]QTE and Collision Fixes:[/b]
  
Improved wall collision detection - characters should no longer end up behind walls, but not guaranteed.
The game and characters now return to their original state if Block QTE sequence is suddenly disrupted.

[b]Other Bug Fixes:[/b]
  
Fixed the attack impulse bug where attacks went in the opposite direction.
Fixed numerous minor bugs (and possibly introduced new ones?).
Repeatedly fixed the gravity loss bug.

notes.title: Update 4.0 - The Titan's Challenge
notes.content:
Embark on a new chapter with the formidable Stormguard, a colossal adversary shrouded in mystery. The fallen guardian, once a symbol of might, adds a fresh layer of complexity to the game's combat dynamics.

Update Notes:

Colossal Adversary: Stormguard introduces innovative blocking mechanics, providing a unique and challenging combat experience. Adapt your strategy to conquer this colossal foe.

Bug Fixes: Smoother and more stable gaming experience.

Enriched Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the world of Kuro with new musical compositions. The atmospheric soundtrack enhances the overall gaming experience.

Post-Death Tips: Receive insightful tips and guidance after each defeat. Learn from your mistakes and evolve your combat strategy with valuable in-game advice.

Controller Vibration: Feel the intensity of each battle with enhanced controller vibrations. A tactile experience adds an extra layer of immersion to every encounter.
